reading: The sketch is a project page header split into three regions: a top toolbar (view toggle Day/Week/Month, an Add task button, page title and date range), a left task table listing grouped tasks with owner badges and progress percentages, and a right Gantt-style timeline with week columns, task bars, milestones, dependency lines and a today marker. Typed notes give exact pixel specs and content for all three regions.

actions.instruction: Build the page toolbar as 7 separate live-text elements, nothing invented or left out, each its own real element: a 178x31 box at 867,14 with 1px #cbd5e1 border
Build a task table (rows, not tabs) in the left column: a 56px tall column-head row with #f8fafc fill spanning the full width, 11px bold #64748b letter-spaced c
Build a Gantt-style timeline in the right column, aligned row-for-row with the task table: a 55px week-header row of 7 equal columns labeled "W10 Mar 2", "W11 M
